9e81bb30: This line does several things: It checks if the variable DG is greater than 9. If so, it calls the subroutine F^DIE17 and sets the variable DE. Then, it sets Y to the value of U and DQ to 18. It calls the subroutine X18. If the variable DIEFIRE is defined, it calls the subroutine FIREREC^DIE17. If Y is undefined or equal to U, it branches to the label A. Otherwise, it sets X to the value of Y, sets DIC(0) to 'F', and sets DW to the value of DQ. Finally, it branches to the subroutine OUT^DIE17.
